scope: Gemma4 E2B greedy generative OCR on the same Apple M4 Max and pinned Q4_0 target/Q8_0 projector/BF16 assistant used in gemma4-ocr-parity-investigation.json. Recognition includes image prep/prefill/decode/HTTP; PDF rendering and startup excluded. Trace and memory-probe times are diagnostic only.

first_divergence.scope: Free-running histories; no canonical KV restoration. Four copies of Attention page 6, two passes.

interpretation.verified: The failed transcript is stopped by a changed greedy EOS decision after an otherwise matching token prefix, rather than lost response bytes. Canonical-prefix-restoring diagnostics did not preserve the free-running state that exposes this difference.
interpretation.arithmetic_scope: Matrix cohorts change operation families/reduction geometry; accumulated numerical KV/hidden drift is supported by same-input projection differences and the free-running logit comparison. No single faulty kernel or invalid KV index has been established.
interpretation.diagnostic_correction: The old CANONICAL_QKV helper used three standalone row linears; ordinary dense Gemma4 uses a fused QKV family with paired K/V reduction. 7736ff8f80 corrects that helper and the local projection reference. Scoped block/projection/tail rollbacks are not equivalent to full canonical decoder execution.
interpretation.serving_fix: Native OCR cohorts retain the complete prepared singleton operation family by default. Matrix arithmetic requires both OCR_MULTIROW and new OCR_MATRIX_ARITHMETIC flags, or an explicit differential diagnostic. Page KV identities, GPU residency and shared cohort frame remain intact.
interpretation.root_cause_limit: The trace proves the early-EOS failure mechanism. Fully isolating every numerical contribution in the experimental matrix lane remains further kernel qualification work; the serving fix avoids that unqualified lane.

recommendation.scope: This campaign only; passing transcripts and disjoint repeated ranges against all ordinary controls. Shared-machine timing still needs independent replication.
